kubeconfig.title: Kubeconfig path
kubeconfig.description: Custom path to kubeconfig file. Leave empty to use default (~/.kube/config or KUBECONFIG).

context.title: Preferred context
context.description: Cluster context override. Leave empty to use the active context from kubeconfig.

namespace.title: Default namespace
namespace.description: Default namespace for cluster queries and commands when not overridden.

allNamespaces.title: Query all namespaces by default
allNamespaces.description: List resources across all namespaces (--all-namespaces) when the explorer opens.

tailLines.title: Log tail lines
tailLines.description: Number of recent log lines to fetch or follow for Pod containers.

shell.title: Container shell
shell.description: Preferred shell executable when opening an interactive terminal in a Pod container.

portForwardLocalPort.title: Default local port for Port Forward
portForwardLocalPort.description: Local port to bind when forwarding a Pod or Service port (0 = match target port).

validateOnSave.title: Inspect manifests on save
validateOnSave.description: Run static Kubernetes manifest inspections (labels, selectors, images, resources, references) when saving YAML files.

dryRunOnSave.title: Run kubectl client dry-run on save
dryRunOnSave.description: Also run `kubectl apply --dry-run=client` when saving a Kubernetes manifest.

warnLatestTag.title: Warn on :latest or unpinned image tags
warnLatestTag.description: Report a warning when a container image uses `:latest` or omits an explicit version tag.

warnMissingResources.title: Warn on missing container resource requests/limits
warnMissingResources.description: Report a warning when a workload container omits `resources.requests` or `resources.limits`.
